mode.label: Read and write
mode.description: One LED for any disk activity, or separate LEDs for reading and writing.

per_disk.label: One LED per disk
per_disk.description: Show separate LEDs for every watched disk instead of one for all of them.

read_color.label: LED color
read_color.description: Color of the shared LED, or of the read LED.

auto_write_color.label: Automatic write color
auto_write_color.description: Use a lighter or darker variant of the LED color for the write LED.

disk_colors.label: Colors per disk
disk_colors.description: Disk name, then a color or "read,write" colors, for example primary,#FF8800. Overrides the colors above for that disk.

size.label: LED size
size.description: Diameter of each LED in pixels.

off_brightness.label: Idle brightness (%)
off_brightness.description: How bright an LED stays while the disks are idle. 0 hides it until there is activity.

glow.label: Glow
glow.description: Soft edge on a lit LED.

disks.label: Disks
disks.description: Device names from /proc/diskstats, for example nvme0n1 or sda. Empty watches every physical disk.

poll_ms.label: Poll interval (ms)
poll_ms.description: How often disk activity is checked. Lower values catch shorter bursts.
